lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh pnpm-lock.yaml weekly, merging once CI passes, so transitive fixes arrive without direct pins (ADR 008 in todofixthis/cookiecutter-browser-plugin).

packageRules.description: Withhold TypeScript 7 until typescript-eslint and typedoc accept it as a peer; both still need the compiler API it dropped (ADR 009 in todofixthis/cookiecutter-browser-plugin).
